goal: Prefill more transactions into compact block announcements so peers rarely need a GETBLOCKTXN round trip
Speeds up block propagation network-wide, benefiting miners and full nodes
reviewability: Author is active and rebased this PR onto the logging split in #35724, ask reviewers to check that first
agreement: Strong concept support from many members with substantive reasons (josibake, ismaelsadeeq, w0xlt, edilmedeiros, murchandamus, 0xB10C, johnnyasantoss)
Tested ACKs backed by measurement data (m4ycon, s00ly, johnnyasantoss)
A use-after-free and stats miscount were found and fixed by the author (andrewtoth)
A logging accuracy bug (always-zero prefilled_size) is being resolved via the rebase onto #35724 (m4ycon)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it raises measured compact block reconstruction success from 56.9% to 89.7% without a protocol change
Benefits the whole network by cutting propagation delay and is backward compatible with unmodified peers
Not P1 since it's an enhancement, not a fix for a correctness, security, or DoS issue

categories.name: build
why: P4 because it only bumps the minimum targeted Windows version to unlock an API needed elsewhere in the PR
Narrow, mechanical change with no independent value outside supporting the p2p feature

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it adds a reusable low-level TCP introspection primitive spanning Linux, BSD, macOS, and Windows
Correctness matters here since platform-specific bugs are easy to introduce, and one was already found and fixed
Its importance is borrowed from the p2p feature rather than being a standalone utils need
